answer: Each agent locks a 60 credit bond to one opal key and stores one signed bundle on an island store. The bundle voyages to that island store, and a public index lists every stored bundle; a missing bundle or missed voyage burns the bond. One opal key stores one bundle only, so a second bundle under the same key is rejected. Each identity pays 60 plus 20 rent; 1000 fakes lock 60,000 and pay 20,000. A rented bundle fails: a copy still bears the original opal signature, so its key match fails and the renter bond burns. An honest agent pays one 20 rent and recovers its bond after a clean epoch.
